answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 166681 Country: Bangladesh Title: Food with "Halal" signed Question: I want to know in some non-Muslim airline provide food with ‘Halal’ signed and in some non-Muslim country also there is some restaurant which supply food with ‘Halal’ signed and also in some conference which is organised by non-Muslim there is also some ‘Halal’ signed food; (meat are also available here with halal signed), whether these food are halal or not? Answer ID: 166681 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 227/158/=03/1440) It is not enough just if ‘halal’ is written on some meat or any item prepared with meat specially when the owner or manager of airline or company or hotel etc who serve the meat or item prepared by meat are non-Muslim. Hence Muslims should avoid eating such food. On such occasions they should prefer on vegetable food and items. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
